# kener_monitor (Data Source)

Fetches a single Kener monitor by its `tag`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kener_monitor" "api" {
  tag = "my-api"
}

output "api_monitor_status" {
  value = data.kener_monitor.api.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `tag` (String) The immutable slug that identifies the monitor.

### Read-Only

- `category_name` (String) Category used to group monitors.
- `confirmation_threshold` (Number) Consecutive checks before a status change is recorded.
- `cron` (String) Cron schedule expression.
- `default_status` (String) Status shown when there is no realtime data.
- `description` (String) Description shown on the status page.
- `external_url` (String) External link.
- `id` (String) Internal numeric identifier.
- `image` (String) Logo/icon URL.
- `include_degraded_in_downtime` (Boolean) Whether DEGRADED counts against uptime.
- `is_hidden` (Boolean) Whether the monitor is hidden.
- `monitor_settings_json` (String) Additional monitor settings as stored by Kener (JSON).
- `monitor_type` (String) Kind of check.
- `name` (String) Human-readable monitor name.
- `status` (String) Whether the monitor is enabled (`ACTIVE`/`INACTIVE`).
- `type_data` (String) Type-specific configuration as stored by Kener (JSON).
